Smartwatches and Wearable ECG/Glucose Status
Medical Accuracy:
Standard consumer smartwatches that claim non-invasive blood glucose tracking lack official medical approval or clinical reliability.
GoodRx
App Integration:
Mainstream smartwatches (like Apple Watch or Android devices) can display real-time data if paired via Bluetooth to an authorized CGM receiver or app (such as FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom apps), but the watch itself does not act as the primary sensor.
Availability:
Al Nahdi Medical Company focuses its wearable and home medical inventory on certified blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, and FDA/SFDA-approved diabetes management systems rather than multi-parameter health smartwatches.
